0g0dio5.title: SELECT v FROM Vet v LEFT JOIN FETCH v.specialties WHERE v.id = :id

steps.text:
SELECT v1_0.id, v1_0.first_name, v1_0.last_name, s1_0.vet_id, s1_1.id, s1_1.description, s1_1.name
FROM vets v1_0
LEFT JOIN vet_specialties s1_0
ON v1_0.id=s1_0.vet_id
LEFT JOIN specialties s1_1
ON s1_1.id=s1_0.specialty_id
WHERE v1_0.id=?
